items.source: Whether the given method return type is supported by this handler.
items.translation: 给定方法返回类型是否由该处理器支持。

items.source: returnType - the type of the return value. This type must have previously been passed to supportsReturnType(org.springframework.core.MethodParameter) and it must have returned true.
items.translation: returnType - 返回值的类型。此类型必须先前已传递给supportsReturnType(org.springframework.core.MethodParameter)，并且它必须返回true。

items.source: Strategy interface to handle the value returned from the invocation of a method handling a Message.
items.translation: 用于处理调用处理 `Message` 的方法后返回值的策略接口。

items.source: true if this handler supports the supplied return type; false otherwise
items.translation: true 如果此处理器支持提供的返回类型；否则为 false。

items.source: Exception - if the return value handling results in an error
items.translation: Exception - 如果返回值处理导致错误

items.source: returnType - the method return type to check
items.translation: returnType - 要检查的方法返回类型

items.source: returnValue - the value returned from the handler method
items.translation: returnValue - 从处理程序方法返回的值

items.source: message - the message that caused this method to be called
items.translation: message - 导致调用此方法的错误消息
